// DISABLED HISTORICAL PROOF: Do not execute. This original test can schedule a real provider worker.

// Re-enable assertions only after a fixture-only inert admission and worker dispatch boundary exists; no real or fake Boat credential.

import { test, expect } from "e2e";
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { backendUrl, siteUrl, project, root } from "../project.ts";

test(
  "agent component history isolates owners and preserves worker state",
  { platforms: ["backend"], tags: ["agent"] },
  async () => {
    const adminKey = process.env.E2E_CONVEX_ADMIN_KEY;
    test.skip(
      !adminKey,
      "E2E_CONVEX_ADMIN_KEY is required for isolated fixtures",
    );
    test.skip(
      !project.features.includes("authentication"),
      "Authentication not selected",
    );
    const url = new URL(backendUrl());
    if (!["127.0.0.1", "localhost", "[::1]"].includes(url.hostname))
      throw new Error("Admin fixtures require a loopback backend");

    async function call(
      path: string,
      args: Record<string, unknown>,
      options: {
        token?: string;
        admin?: boolean;
        componentPath?: string;
        mutation?: boolean;
        action?: boolean;
      } = {},
    ) {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${url.origin}/api/${options.admin ? "function" : options.action ? "action" : options.mutation ? "mutation" : "query"}`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            ...(options.admin
              ? { Authorization: `Convex ${adminKey}` }
              : options.token
                ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}` }
                : {}),
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            path,
            args,
            format: "json",
            ...(options.componentPath
              ? { componentPath: options.componentPath }
              : {}),
          }),
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
        },
      );
      return response.json();
    }
    async function value(
      path: string,
      args: Record<string, unknown>,
      options: Parameters<typeof call>[2] = {},
    ) {
      const result = await call(path, args, options);
      if (result.status !== "success")
        throw new Error(
          `${path} failed: ${result.errorMessage ?? result.status}`,
        );
      return result.value;
    }
    const boatResponse = await fetch(`${url.origin}/api/query`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: `Convex ${adminKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        path: "_system/cli/queryEnvironmentVariables:get",
        args: { name: "BOAT_API_KEY" },
        format: "json",
      }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
    });
    const boat = await boatResponse.json();
    if (boat.status !== "success")
      throw new Error("Unable to verify the isolated agent configuration.");
    test.skip(
      !boat.value?.value?.trim(),
      "Remote agent configuration is absent",
    );
    async function user() {
      const signup = await value(
        "auth:signUpWithUsernamePassword",
        {
          username: `agenttest${randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "")}`,
          password: `Agent-${randomUUID()}!`,
        },
        { mutation: true },
      );
      expect(signup.status).toBe("complete");
      const token = signup.tokens.accessToken as string;
      const current = await value("users/index:current", {}, { token });
      return { token, id: current.id as string };
    }
    const owner = await user();
    const other = await user();
    expect(await value("agent/index:getMessages", {})).toBe(null);
    expect(
      (
        await call(
          "agent/index:sendMessageChecked",
          { prompt: "fixture" },
          { action: true },
        )
      ).status,
    ).toBe("error");
    expect(
      (
        await call(
          "agent/index:abortMessage",
          { appId: randomUUID() },
          { mutation: true },
        )
      ).status,
    ).toBe("error");
    expect(
      (await value("agent/index:getMessages", {}, { token: owner.token })).page,
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      (
        await call(
          "agent/index:getMessages",
          { appId: randomUUID() },
          { token: owner.token },
        )
      ).status,
    ).toBe("error");
    const appId = randomUUID();
    const created = await value(
      "threads:createThread",
      { userId: owner.id, title: "Agent fixture" },
      { admin: true, componentPath: "agent" },
    );
    const id = created._id as string;
    function cli(args: string[]) {
      const result = spawnSync(
        process.execPath,
        [
          join(
            dirname(
              createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve("convex/package.json"),
            ),
            "bin/main.js",
          ),
          ...args,
          "--url",
          url.origin,
          "--admin-key",
          adminKey!,
        ],
        {
          cwd: join(root, "packages/backend"),
          encoding: "utf8",
        },
      );
      if (result.status !== 0)
        throw new Error(
          `Convex fixture ${args[0]} failed: ${(result.error?.message ?? result.stderr).replaceAll(adminKey!, "[redacted]")}`,
        );
      return result.stdout;
    }
    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "disposabl-agent-e2e-"));
    try {
      const file = join(dir, "apps.json");
      writeFileSync(
        file,
        JSON.stringify([
          {
            appId,
            userId: owner.id,
            name: "Agent fixture",
            platforms: ["web"],
            features: ["authentication"],
            agent: {
              threadId: id,
              status: "processing",
              pending: [],
              updatedAt: Date.now(),
              startedAt: Date.now() - 2000,
            },
          },
        ]),
      );
      cli(["import", "--append", "--table", "apps", file]);
    } finally {
      rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
    const token = randomUUID();
    let agentBearer =
      "disposabl_agent_" +
      randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "") +
      randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "");
    const apiOrigin = new URL(siteUrl());
    if (!["127.0.0.1", "localhost", "[::1]"].includes(apiOrigin.hostname))
      throw new Error("Agent API fixtures require a loopback site");
    async function rest(
      path: string,
      args: Record<string, unknown>,
      method = "GET",
      bearer = agentBearer,
    ) {
      const endpoint = new URL(`/api/${path}`, apiOrigin);
      if (method === "GET")
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(args))
          endpoint.searchParams.set(key, JSON.stringify(value));
      return fetch(endpoint, {
        method,
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${bearer}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        ...(method === "POST" ? { body: JSON.stringify(args) } : {}),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
      });
    }
    let claimed = false;
    try {
      const claim = await value(
        "agent/state:claim",
        { id, token },
        { admin: true },
      );
      claimed = true;
      expect(claim).toMatchObject({
        appId,
        threadId: id,
        status: "processing",
        lease: { token },
      });
      const grant = () =>
        value(
          "agent/access:issue",
          {
            id,
            token,
            hash: createHash("sha256").update(agentBearer).digest("hex"),
          },
          { admin: true },
        );
      await grant();
      expect((await rest("apps/get", { appId })).status).toBe(200);
      function cliStatus(bearer: string, expiresAt = Date.now() + 14_400_000) {
        const sessionDirectory = mkdtempSync(
          join(tmpdir(), "disposabl-agent-session-"),
        );
        try {
          writeFileSync(
            join(
              sessionDirectory,
              `${createHash("sha256").update(apiOrigin.origin).digest("hex")}.json`,
            ),
            JSON.stringify({
              tokens: {
                access_token: bearer,
                token_type: "Bearer",
                expires_in: 14_400,
              },
              expiresAt,
            }),
            { mode: 0o600 },
          );
          const login = spawnSync(
            "bun",
            [join(root, "packages/cli/index.ts"), "login", "status"],
            {
              cwd: root,
              encoding: "utf8",
              timeout: 30_000,
              env: {
                ...process.env,
                DISPOSABL_API_ORIGIN: apiOrigin.origin,
                DISPOSABL_CONFIG_DIR: sessionDirectory,
                DISPOSABL_API_KEY: "",
                E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1",
              },
            },
          );
          expect(login.status).toBe(0);
          expect((login.stdout + login.stderr).includes(bearer)).toBe(false);
          return JSON.parse(login.stdout).currentUser;
        } finally {
          rmSync(sessionDirectory, { recursive: true, force: true });
        }
      }
      expect(cliStatus(agentBearer).id).toBe(owner.id);
      expect(cliStatus(agentBearer, 0)).toBeNull();
      expect((await rest("apps/get", { appId: randomUUID() })).status).toBe(
        403,
      );
      expect(
        (
          await rest("apps/list", {
            paginationOpts: { numItems: 10, cursor: null },
          })
        ).status,
      ).toBe(403);
      expect(
        (
          await rest(
            "agent/sendMessage",
            { appId, prompt: "Must not recurse" },
            "POST",
          )
        ).status,
      ).toBe(403);
      expect(
        (
          await rest(
            "apps/delete",
            { appId, dangerouslyDeleteApp: true },
            "POST",
          )
        ).status,
      ).toBe(403);
      const previousBearer = agentBearer;
      agentBearer =
        "disposabl_agent_" +
        randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "") +
        randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "");
      await grant();
      expect(
        (await rest("apps/get", { appId }, "GET", previousBearer)).status,
      ).toBe(401);
      expect(cliStatus(previousBearer)).toBeNull();
      expect((await rest("apps/get", { appId })).status).toBe(200);
      expect(
        await value(
          "agent/state:claim",
          { id, token: randomUUID() },
          { admin: true },
        ),
      ).toBeNull();
      expect(
        (
          await call(
            "agent/state:append",
            { id, token: randomUUID(), events: [] },
            { admin: true },
          )
        ).status,
      ).toBe("error");
      for (const [index, content] of [
        "First fixture reply",
        "Second fixture reply",
      ].entries()) {
        await value(
          "agent/state:append",
          {
            id,
            token,
            events: [
              {
                id: `fixture-${index}`,
                content,
                streaming: false,
                reverted: false,
              },
            ],
            cursor: `cursor-${index}`,
          },
          { admin: true },
        );
      }
      const list = await value(
        "agent/index:getMessages",
        {},
        { token: owner.token },
      );
      expect(list.page).toMatchObject([
        { appId, threadId: id, name: "Agent fixture", status: "processing" },
      ]);
      expect(
        (await value("agent/index:getMessages", {}, { token: other.token }))
          .page,
      ).toEqual([]);
      expect(
        (
          await call(
            "agent/index:getMessages",
            { appId },
            { token: other.token },
          )
        ).status,
      ).toBe("error");
      const first = await value(
        "agent/index:getMessages",
        { appId, paginationOpts: { numItems: 1, cursor: null } },
        { token: owner.token },
      );
      expect(first.kind).toBe("messages");
      expect(first.page).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(first.isDone).toBe(false);
      const second = await value(
        "agent/index:getMessages",
        {
          appId,
          paginationOpts: { numItems: 1, cursor: first.continueCursor },
        },
        { token: owner.token },
      );
      expect(second.page).toHaveLength(1);
      expect([first.page[0].content, second.page[0].content].sort()).toEqual([
        "First fixture reply",
        "Second fixture reply",
      ]);
      const apps = JSON.parse(
        cli(["data", "apps", "--format", "json", "--limit", "1000"]),
      );
      const stored = apps.find((app: { appId: string }) => app.appId === appId);
      expect(stored.agent).toMatchObject({
        threadId: id,
        status: "processing",
        cursor: "cursor-1",
        lease: { token },
      });
      // The held lease keeps the scheduled worker from contacting Boat.
      const attachmentId = await value(
        "files/index:upload",
        {
          filename: "reference.txt",
          mediaType: "text/plain",
          bytes: {
            $bytes: Buffer.from("Project reference fixture").toString("base64"),
          },
        },
        { token: owner.token, action: true },
      );
      expect(
        (
          await call(
            "agent/attachments:get",
            { userId: other.id, ids: [attachmentId] },
            { admin: true },
          )
        ).status,
      ).toBe("error");
      const sent = await value(
        "agent/index:sendMessageChecked",
        { appId, prompt: "Queued fixture prompt", fileIds: [attachmentId] },
        { token: owner.token, action: true },
      );
      expect(sent).toMatchObject({ appId, threadId: id, status: "processing" });
      expect(
        (
          await call(
            "agent/index:sendMessageChecked",
            { appId, prompt: "Forbidden" },
            { token: other.token, action: true },
          )
        ).status,
      ).toBe("error");
      const stopping = await value(
        "agent/index:abortMessage",
        { appId },
        { token: owner.token, mutation: true },
      );
      expect(stopping.status).toBe("stopping");
      expect((await rest("apps/get", { appId })).status).toBe(401);
      const messages = await value(
        "agent/index:getMessages",
        { appId },
        { token: owner.token },
      );
      expect(
        messages.page.find(
          (m: { content: string }) => m.content === "Queued fixture prompt",
        ).attachments,
      ).toEqual([
        {
          id: attachmentId,
          filename: "reference.txt",
          mediaType: "text/plain",
        },
      ]);
      expect(
        messages.page.find(
          (m: { content: string }) => m.content === "Queued fixture prompt",
        ).status,
      ).toBe("failed");
      await value(
        "agent/state:finish",
        { id, token, stopped: true },
        { admin: true },
      );
      claimed = false;
      await value(
        "files/index:remove",
        { id: attachmentId },
        { token: owner.token, action: true },
      );
      const aborted = await value(
        "agent/index:abortMessage",
        { appId },
        { token: owner.token, mutation: true },
      );
      expect(aborted).toMatchObject({ appId, threadId: id, status: "idle" });
      const completedHistory = await value(
        "agent/index:getMessages",
        { appId },
        { token: owner.token },
      );
      expect(completedHistory.startedAt).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(completedHistory.finishedAt).toBeGreaterThan(
        completedHistory.startedAt,
      );
      expect(
        (
          await call(
            "agent/index:abortMessage",
            { appId },
            { token: other.token, mutation: true },
          )
        ).status,
      ).toBe("error");
    } finally {
      if (claimed)
        await value(
          "agent/state:finish",
          { id, token, stopped: true },
          { admin: true },
        );
    }
  },
);
